THE SCREEN CAN WAIT

Open a very small museum.

Put your two objects together—or describe them. Give the pair one impossible job. A teaspoon and a sock might become a lighthouse for ants. Each add a sentence to the exhibit’s story.

A
Find or imagine an object with a color you like.

B
Find or imagine an object with an interesting shape.

Nothing nearby? Imaginary objects count. Change anything that doesn’t suit you.

0:45

Optional. Time never ends your moment.
